target: Primer Dialog title/subtitle, action buttons, close gestures and focus-ref conventions
observed_behavior: Primer's Dialog props document a required-purpose title in examples; its title is also exposed as the dialog's aria-label, and an optional subtitle serves as aria-describedby. The example defines onClose and returnFocusRef pointing at its trigger; the props describe onClose receiving either a close-button or Escape gesture, and initialFocusRef as a ref to the element to focus on opening. Footer buttons may be configured by buttonType and content, with autoFocus applying when only one button requests it. The close-button prop and example identify a top-right X close control; these are documented API and example conventions, not verified runtime results.
context: W07 Stage B5 K3; authorized Primer product page section: Dialog React examples (default, subtitle, footer); Props — Dialog and DialogButtonProps. Explanatory product API/design documentation within Primer only.
limitations: The title-to-aria-label and subtitle-to-aria-describedby claims are Primer's documented component contract, not universal recommendations for all dialog implementations.
returnFocusRef is shown in examples; the page does not demonstrate that return always succeeds after an invoker disappears or across all conditions.
The onClose gesture list documents close-button and Escape for this component; it does not document every possible dismissal path or imply automatic overlay-click close.
One-button autoFocus condition is explicit, not permission to assume which action should receive first focus in every task.
React experimental import appears in examples while page labels React ready; no pinned React source or actual browser focus behavior was inspected.
